supporting.title: A glass of water with each meal
Keep a piece of fruit where you can see it

days.title: Add one vegetable to lunch and take {minutes} minutes to enjoy it
days.reason: Adding something good is easier than cutting things out.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes planning one home-cooked meal
days.reason: A little planning makes healthy meals easier.

days.title: Eat one meal slowly, taking {minutes} minutes or more
days.reason: Eating slowly helps you notice when you feel full.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes washing and cutting fruit or vegetables for snacks
days.reason: Ready snacks make good choices easy.

days.title: Swap one sugary drink for water and take {minutes} minutes to notice the difference
days.reason: Small swaps add up over time.

days.title: Try a new fruit or vegetable and spend {minutes} minutes preparing it
days.reason: Trying new foods keeps healthy eating interesting.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes writing down one food habit you want to keep
days.reason: Noticing what works helps it last.
